title: Bo Nix and Broncos’ offense preparing to battle revamped Rams defense

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bo Nix and Broncos’ offense preparing to battle revamped Rams defense
sources.description: The Los Angeles Rams made a lot of moves to improve their defense this past offseason. Can Bo Nix and the Broncos’ defense find a way to topple them on Sunday Night Football?
